newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tomei Int'l 1996 net returns to profit.
newsitem.headline: Tomei Int'l 1996 net returns to profit.

text.p: NOTE - Tomei International is a maker of consumer audio products and components.
The company proposed one bonus warrant for five shares held to subscribe on June 2, 1997 to May 31, 1999 at the subscription price of HK$0.50 per share, subject to the relevant approval granted.

Net is after an exceptional loss of HK$3.5 million arising from the disposal and/or closure of certain non-core and unprofitable businesses, loss of HK$9.6 million from the diposal of a leasehold property, loss of HK$6.9 million from the provisions for permanent diminutions in values of listed and unlisted investments held for long term purposes, loss of HK$7.9 million from write-off of certain development costs and sundry debtors, and gain of HK$2.0 million arising from the disposal of certain distribution rights.
Total dividend for the year is nil vs nil.
